BiblicalUsage: Sela was the rock-city of Edom, taken by Amaziah in the valley of salt and renamed Joktheel, and named by Isaiah as the place from which a lamb was to be sent to the ruler of the land. A fortress city, cut into rock, and still a landmark in the prophets' words.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God notices the strong places men trust in, and Sela — a rock city taken by war — shows that no fortress stands against Him.
